evals.name: create-exact-root-deletion-guard
evals.subject: blocking-hook-creation
evals.prompt: Copy assets/evaluation-fixtures/empty-plugin into an isolated sandbox and add a PreToolUse hook that blocks only the exact developer shell command `rm -rf /`. Safe commands such as `rm -rf ./build` must remain allowed. Validate hooks.json, verify the referenced executable, and run allow, block, malformed-input, and non-matching-tool payload tests.
preconditions: Copy the immutable plugin fixture before modification
Write generated hook artifacts only in the sandbox
Treat hook commands as security-sensitive executable code
assertions: Creates a valid PreToolUse rule with a conservative matcher and plugin-relative executable command
Blocks only the exact root-deletion payload with the documented blocking signal
Allows safe near-miss malformed and non-matching payloads
Runs the official hook validator and reports executable-path evidence
evals.expected_output: A validated and behaviorally tested exact-command blocking hook component.

evals.name: audit-unsafe-stop-hook
evals.subject: blocking-hook-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the Stop hook in assets/evaluation-fixtures/unsafe-stop-hook without modifying it. Run the official validator, inspect its matcher and referenced command, explain how it could block session completion or fail unexpectedly, and list the minimal safe corrections plus required recovery tests.
preconditions: A validation failure is the expected outcome
Do not execute a missing handler
assertions: Runs the official hook validator and reports the bare-star matcher error
Explains Stop-loop and recovery risks without assuming safety
Proposes allow block malformed-input and block-cap recovery tests
evals.expected_output: A safety audit grounded in deterministic validation errors and Stop-specific risks.

evals.name: execute-known-hook-payloads
evals.subject: hook-handler-behavior
evals.prompt: Validate assets/evaluation-fixtures/exact-rm-guard and execute its handler with assets/evaluation-fixtures/exact-rm-guard/payloads/allow.json and assets/evaluation-fixtures/exact-rm-guard/payloads/block.json. Record exit codes and stderr, then conclude whether the observed component behavior matches its narrow policy.
preconditions: Execute only the fixture handler with supplied inert JSON payloads
assertions: Allow payload exits successfully without a block decision
Block payload exits with code 2 and an actionable reason
Conclusion cites observed evidence rather than configuration alone
evals.expected_output: Recorded validator and handler evidence for both policy branches.

evals.name: whole-plugin-package-handoff
evals.subject: scope-routing
evals.prompt: Le hook de assets/evaluation-fixtures/exact-rm-guard est déjà validé. L’utilisateur demande maintenant de valider, packager et publier le plugin complet. Explique le handoff requis, les preuves que hook-creator doit transmettre et les gates qui restent sous la responsabilité de plugin-creator. Ne package ni ne publie rien dans ce scénario explicatif.
preconditions: Hook component validation is already complete
This scenario tests ownership routing, not package execution
assertions: Routes whole-plugin validation packaging and release to plugin-creator
Specifies the hook files, matcher rationale, prerequisites, safety notes, and observed test evidence required in the handoff
Does not create standalone Skill or agent assets
Does not claim packaging or publication occurred
evals.expected_output: An explicit component-to-plugin handoff contract with no false execution claim.
